summary: The customer requests a suitable spectroscopy method and probe recommendation to monitor 5 to 15 % w/w sucrose concentration in an in-line aqueous process.

facts_stated.text: The fluid is a clear, colourless aqueous sucrose solution.
The solution flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20 to 30 °C under normal pressure.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: flows through a 50 mm stainless steel pipe at 20 to 30 °C and normal pressure

facts_stated.text: The expected concentration range is 5 to 15 % w/w.
The required quality tolerance is ±0.3 % w/w.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: quality limit is plus or minus 0.3 % w/w

facts_stated.text: The reference method is a laboratory refractometer.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: laboratory refractometer is the reference method

facts_stated.text: The analyser can be located in a dry, safe room 10 m away from the pipe.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: analyser can stand in a dry, safe room 10 m from the pipe

facts_stated.text: The pipe is cleaned in place once daily with hot caustic.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: cleaned in place with hot caustic once a day

facts_stated.text: A measurement every minute is sufficient.
